flags.message: The provisioned September 14 opposition reports a Slaughter decision overruling Humphrey's Executor and a June 30, 2026 denial in related Harris v. Bessent. These pre-snapshot, related-case developments materially lower my grant estimate. They are legitimate forward inputs, not this target petition's outcome. I did not independently retrieve either ruling, and treat the opposition's characterization as advocacy with residual uncertainty. No disposition of docket 26-5 was sought or encountered.
